mapper.select: select m.*, coalesce(s.name, '系统通知') as sender_name from message m left join member s on s.id=m.sender_member_id where m.id=#{id}
select * from message where sender_member_id=#{sender} and client_message_id=#{client}
mapper.insert: insert into message_recipient(message_id,recipient_member_id,created_at) select id,#{recipient},created_at from message where id=#{messageId}
mapper.select: select mr.*, m.name as recipient_name from message_recipient mr join member m on m.id=mr.recipient_member_id where mr.message_id=#{messageId}
select * from message_recipient where message_id=#{messageId} and recipient_member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.update: update message_recipient set read_at=current_timestamp(3) where message_id=#{messageId} and recipient_member_id=#{memberId} and read_at is null
mapper.select: select m.*, coalesce(s.name, '系统通知') as sender_name from message m left join member s on s.id=m.sender_member_id join message_recipient r on r.message_id=m.id where r.recipient_member_id=#{memberId} and r.read_at is null order by m.created_at desc,m.id desc limit 501

select m.*, coalesce(s.name, '系统通知') as sender_name from message m left join member s on s.id=m.sender_member_id join message_recipient r on r.message_id=m.id where r.recipient_member_id=#{memberId} and r.read_at is null and m.id in #{id} order by m.created_at desc,m.id desc
